2155. Calculating an Electricity Bill Using a Function

80

Hard

Problem Statement
Read the number of electricity units consumed and print the bill amount, using a function that applies slab-wise rates.

Description
An electricity board charges Rs.3 per unit for the first 100 units, Rs.5 per unit for the next 100 units (units 101 to 200), and Rs.8 per unit for every unit above 200. Read an integer units from input. Write a function calculateBill that takes the units as a parameter, uses an if-else-if ladder to apply the rates slab by slab, and returns the total bill. Print the returned bill from main().
input_spec:
. Write a function calculateBill that takes the units as a parameter, uses an if-else-if ladder to apply the rates slab by slab, and returns the total bill. Print the returned bill from main().

Input Description
A single integer units (units >= 0).
